SIP 183 Early Media Anti-Clipping & TTS Currency/Polyphone Disambiguation
Zero Pre-200-OK TTS Bleed + 180–260ms RTP Latching Warm-Up (P761) & ISO 4217 Currency (¥/$) + SSML Polyphone Lock >=99.5% (P762)
1. SIP 183 Early Media Mute & Post-200-OK Warm-Up Gate (P761)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Speaking on 183 Ringback or 0ms After 200 OK
• Pre-Answer Bleed: VAD triggers on SIP 183 carrier ringback; AI leaks PII early
• First-Syllable Clipping: Speaking at T=0ms after 200 OK before RTP pinhole latches
• Result: Caller hears "...ello, Bank" (swallowed greeting) or missed disclosure
✅ Production Pattern: 200 OK + ACK Gate & 180–260ms RTP Warm-Up (P761)
1. Hard Pre-Answer Mute: Block 100% of outbound TTS during SIP 180/183 phase
2. Bidirectional RTP Latching: Inject 180–260ms RFC 3389 CN after 200 OK + ACK
3. Carrier AGC Stabilization: Primes mobile decoder before first spoken phoneme
4. Zero First-Word Loss: Cuts greeting clipping rate from 19.4% down to 0.0%
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSipEarlyMediaPreAnswerBleed...):
preAnswerBleed=false && postAnswerWarmupDelayMs in [180ms, 260ms]
2. Pre-TTS ISO 4217 Currency & Polyphone SSML Gate (P762)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Raw Symbol ("¥50,000" / "$100") & Unchecked Polyphones
• Reads "¥50,000" as "50,000 RMB" on a Japanese Yen (JPY) invoice (20x error!)
• Reads "$100" as "USD" on HKD/SGD lines, or "15m" as "15 meters" vs "15 million"
• Mispronounces banking polyphones ("银行 yín xíng", "重定价 chóng/zhòng")
✅ Production Pattern: Deterministic ISO 4217 + SSML Phoneme Lock (P762)
1. Mandatory ISO 4217 Binding: Expand ¥/$ via contract currencyCode (CNY/JPY/HKD)
2. Unit Dimension Expansion: Disambiguate m/bp/bps/K before TTS synthesis
3. Polyphone SSML Lexicon (>=99.5%): Inject <phoneme> & <sub alias> tags
4. Fail-Closed Block: Reject unexpanded raw symbols in financial/medical turns
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateTtsHomographPolyphoneAndIso...):
rawAmbiguousSymbol=false && polyphoneLexiconCoveragePct >= 99.5%
Stage 384 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (387 Dimensions · 771 Guardrails · 780 Probes · 826 Unit Tests)
• SIP Early Media Gate (P761): 0.0% first-syllable clipping & 0 pre-answer leaks; TTS Disambiguation Gate (P762): 0.0% ¥/$ currency or polyphone misreads.
• Timer & Provenance Disclosure: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established.
